description: Math for vials holding two or more peptides (KLOW, GLOW, BPC-157 + TB-500, CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin): units to draw and how much of each peptide one draw delivers. Name a known blend or list the components, then give the dose for one component (targetPeptide) or for the whole blend (totalDose).

blend.description: A blend TruePeptideSource covers, e.g. "KLOW", "GLOW", "BPC-157 + TB-500". Its label amounts are used unless components is given.

amount.description: Amount of this peptide in the vial.

peptide.description: Peptide name, alias or slug, e.g. "BPC-157", "reta", "semaglutide", "CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin".

composition.description: For a blend sold in several versions, which one, e.g. "70 mg". Omit for the first; the result lists the others.

dose.description: Dose of targetPeptide, or of the whole blend when totalDose is true.

doseUnit.description: Unit of the dose: mcg or mg.

syringe.description: Insulin syringe type. "U-100" (the common 1 mL / 0.5 mL / 0.3 mL insulin syringe) unless the user says otherwise.

targetPeptide.description: The component the dose is for. Use with dose.

totalDose.description: True when the dose is for the whole blend ("2 mg of KLOW"), false when it is for targetPeptide.

name: peptide_blend_calculator
title: Blend vial calculator
